TRIP STYLE

Fly-in & remote lodge

Use a remote lodge or an air transfer as the base for a fishing trip. Travel and equipment limits shape the plan.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who want several days based near remote water and can accept travel changes.

Boats & gear

Confirm aircraft baggage limits, transfers, boats, guide support and supplied tackle directly with the lodge.

Seasons

Operating dates and weather delays differ by lodge. Confirm the transfer schedule and a spare travel day.
